prerequisites.en: Engineering Mechanics (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI03006041)

name.en: Shear Force and Bending Moment in Beams
name.gu: Beam માં Shear Force અને Bending Moment

name.en: Bending and Shear Stress in Beams
name.gu: Beam માં Bending અને Shear Stress

text.en: Analyse structural behaviour of various materials under axial loading.
text.gu: Axial loading હેઠળ જુદી materials ના structural behaviour નું analysis કરો.

text.en: Determine moment of inertia of a symmetrical and asymmetrical section about a given axis.
text.gu: Symmetrical અને asymmetrical section નો આપેલ axis પર moment of inertia શોધો.

text.en: Draw and interpret shear force and bending moment diagrams and determine bending and shear stresses in beams for various types and loading conditions.
text.gu: Shear force અને bending moment diagrams દોરો, સમજાવો અને beam માં bending તથા shear stresses શોધો.

text.en: Determine slope and deflection in cantilever and simply supported beams.
text.gu: Cantilever અને simply supported beam માં slope અને deflection શોધો.

text.en: Determine axial forces in the members of simple truss.
text.gu: Simple truss ના members માં axial forces શોધો.

text.en: Analyse the column for axial load with various end conditions.
text.gu: જુદી end conditions સાથે column નું axial load માટે analysis કરો.
